sources.claim: node:sqlite is stability 1.2 (release candidate), DatabaseSync is synchronous, and DatabaseSync supports a busy timeout.
node:http is stability 2 (stable), and server.close() stops acceptance and closes idle connections.
Worker threads are stability 2 (stable), worker messages use postMessage(), and messages are emitted before exit.
Node 24.20.0 publishes official binaries for Linux x64 and arm64, Windows x64 and arm64, and macOS x64 and arm64.
--throw-deprecation affects DeprecationWarning; it does not replace explicit capture of other warning names such as ExperimentalWarning.
The process warning event exposes the warning name, message, code, and stack.
WAL allows readers and one writer concurrently, still permits only one writer, and defaults to automatic checkpoints near 1,000 pages and when the last connection closes.
The WAL-reset corruption bug affects 3.7.0 through 3.51.2 and is fixed in 3.51.3 and later, with backports in 3.44.6 and 3.50.7.
SQLite 3.53.0 includes the WAL-reset bug fix, and 3.53.4 is the current patch release captured for this experiment.
SQLite permits multiple readers but only one simultaneous writer; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction and may return SQLITE_BUSY.
